name: The Soldier
description: An aberration of Jace who advises killing swiftly and plucks out the part of the Theorist's mind that remembers how to breathe.

description_citations.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The Detective explains that the body is connected to the illusion and proposes that killing the body will stall the overlay, and that they need the Soldier.
timeline.quote: We'll need to find him. Then we'll have a chance to finish the task and eliminate the body.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The Soldier, a boy in a memory trap of a camp of dead soldiers, recognizes Vraska approaching and salutes her.
timeline.quote: The Soldier sees Vraska approaching and straightens into a salute.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The Soldier asks for help and admits he is the reason she could not love all of him.
timeline.quote: "I'm the reason you couldn't love all of me.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Vraska embraces the Soldier and tells him she loves him as she loves Jace.
timeline.quote: You're part of him, and I love you as I love him."

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The Soldier says death is a change in state and dives into Vraska's mind.
timeline.quote: he soundlessly disappears his body and dives into her mind.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Vraska plans to be launched by Chandra's explosion to petrify her double, guided by the aberrations in her mind.
timeline.quote: "You're going to launch me high enough that I can petrify my double."

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The aberrations rush into the Theorist and overtake his mind, each taking a role in subduing him.
timeline.quote: They overtake his mind like a tsunami.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The aberrations reintegrate into one and Jace opens his eyes, whole again.
timeline.quote: Plural becomes singular. The aberrations, the parts, become one.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

pages_say.description: Another aberration of Jace whom the Detective says they need to find.

pages_say.description: A boy-aged part of Jace, the sphinx's prodigy and weapon, trapped in a memory of a Vrynian army camp of dead soldiers; Vraska embraces him and he joins her mind.
